newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 4.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 4.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A delegation of the International Monetary Fund arrived in Budapest to collect information about economic processes and the 1997 budget.
- Labour experts said they expected Hungary's unemployment rate to remain around 10 percent for the long term.
- The State Audit Office said the (state) Pension Fund's accounting system is not suitable for measuring performance and for fast and professional work.
- The social security funds expressed concern over the Parliament's Tuesday decision which strengthened government control on the funds.
